# Copilot Instructions

- **Project scope**: This is a desktop image viewer built with LCUI (C) plus React-like UI definitions compiled to C. Entry point lives in [src/main.c](src/main.c); it launches the image view when a file path is passed, otherwise shows the home screen.
- **Build workflow**: Install Node + `@lcui/cli`, then `npm install` (or `yarn install` per packageManager). Run `lcui build` to convert `.tsx/.scss/.css` into C headers, then `xmake` to compile, `xmake run` to launch (run dir is `dist/`). When UI assets change, re-run `lcui build` before rebuilding C.
- **Generated artifacts**: Files `*.tsx.h`, `*.scss.h`, `*.css.h` under `src/` are generated—never edit them. Edit the source `.tsx/.scss/.css` instead and regenerate with `lcui build`.
- **UI definition pattern**: UI layout lives in React-like components using `@lcui/react` (e.g., [src/image-view.tsx](src/image-view.tsx), [src/home.tsx](src/home.tsx)). `$ref` names become fields on `*_react_t` structs in generated headers. Event handler strings (e.g., `onMouseDown="image_view_on_mousedown"`) must correspond to C functions defined in the paired C file (see [src/image-view.c](src/image-view.c)).
- **Runtime bridge**: C files include the generated headers (`#include "image-view.tsx.h"`) and call `*_react_init/update/destroy` helpers to keep the UI tree synced (see [src/image-view.c](src/image-view.c)). Keep `$ref` names and handler names aligned between TSX and C.
- **Image flow**: `image_controller_t` in [src/image-controller.c](src/image-controller.c) manages zoom/pan bounds; `image_view_update()` in [src/image-view.c](src/image-view.c) applies controller state to widget styles and toggles controls. `image_collector_*` handles prev/next sequencing; `file_info_reader_*` populates metadata. Use these instead of reinventing file/zoom logic.
- **Keyboard/mouse handling**: Keyboard shortcuts (e.g., +/- for zoom, arrows for navigation) are wired via a root keydown listener in [src/image-view.c](src/image-view.c). Mouse dragging/scrolling pan/zoom uses viewport offsets; maintain the existing boundary checks in `image_controller_set_position()` when altering interactions.
- **Home screen**: [src/home.tsx](src/home.tsx) renders name/version from package.json and a basic usage hint; keep it minimal and language-consistent with current Chinese copy.
- **Styling**: Uses Tailwind-like utility classes plus Sass; global styles in [src/global.css](src/global.css). Icons come from `@lcui/react-icons` with their CSS imported at the component level (see [src/image-view.tsx](src/image-view.tsx)).
- **Build config**: Xmake target defined in [xmake.lua](xmake.lua) pulls in `vendor/LCUI/xmake.lua`, sets warnings as errors, and defines `_CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS`. Release on Windows applies `win.sdk.application` rule.
- **Coding conventions (C)**: Follow [vendor/LCUI/AGENTS.md](vendor/LCUI/AGENTS.md): 8-space indentation; source files ordered as preprocessor, types, globals, declarations, then definitions grouped by feature dependency instead of forward-declaring. Prefer reordering functions over adding prototypes.
- **Testing**: LCUI upstream pattern places tests under `tests/cases` with filenames prefixed `test_` and includes `<ctest-custom.h>`; add calls in `tests/run_tests.c` when creating new cases (see [vendor/LCUI/AGENTS.md](vendor/LCUI/AGENTS.md)). This repo currently has no project-specific test scripts.
- **Third-party code**: `vendor/LCUI` is upstream; avoid modifying unless intended. `vendor.node_modules` hosts vendored JS deps for LCUI tooling—treat as generated.
- **Common pitfalls**: Forgetting `lcui build` causes missing `*.h` during xmake; mismatched handler names between TSX and C lead to dead events; editing generated headers will be lost on rebuild.
